title: Streaming session salvage: mid-request repair, deduplication, and capacity-aware backpressure tuning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: A capacity surge on 2026-03-09 caused a cluster-wide degradation in streaming responses: intermittent disconnects, partial/duplicated tokens delivered to clients, and degraded resume behavior for long-lived sessions. This ticket tracks post-incident remediation work focused on (1) on-path mid-request repair and deduplication, (2) more conservative/explicit backpressure hysteresis tied to capacity headroom, and (3) telemetry/runbook improvements for faster incident detection and safe rollouts. The goal is to eliminate user-visible partial tokens and improve successful resume rates to >99.9% under 2x baseline load spikes.
updates: 2026-03-09: Incident declared at 11:42 UTC after Grafana alarm: streaming_session_complete_rate dropped 42% and token_gap_count increased. Initial mitigation: rerouted traffic to lower-utilized regions and increased short-term capacity via burst pool; enabled temporary connection keepalive extension to reduce socket churn. (on-call: Liam Chen)

2026-03-09: Emergency hotfix deployed to disable aggressive client-side chunk coalescing that caused partial-token delivery during backpressure; this reduced partial-token reports by ~60% within 30 minutes. Deployed as Canary to 5% then 50% then 100% traffic. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6142

2026-03-10: Root cause analysis preliminary: a combination of (a) transient capacity saturation causing queue reordering and partial write buffers, (b) KV cache eviction mismatch during resume handshake, and (c) backpressure hysteresis thresholds that rapidly flipped between 'accept' and 'throttle' states. Repro harness created and failcases captured in staging. Related incidents: ENG-21450 backlog analysis and ENG-27801 surge thresholds work.

2026-03-11: Design review with PM and Reliability: agreed on three tracks (repair & dedupe, backpressure policy, telemetry & runbook). Prioritized by customer-impact and implementation risk. Action items created and owners assigned.

2026-03-13: Implemented additional session checkpointing token (idempotent resume token) as an experimental flag for Canary; observed 2x improvement in successful resume without extra latency in Canary traffic. Canary metrics: resume_success_rate rose from 91.2% to 99.3% at 50% load spike injection. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/streaming/pull/820

2026-03-14: Security/Privacy review completed for checkpoint metadata storage (TTL=4h, encrypted). No PII included. Decision: enable by default after one more week of load testing. (Reviewer: Priya Nair)
action_items: Implement mid-request token reassembly middleware in the output fanout path; ensure idempotent delivery semantics and deterministic ordering. Owner: Liam Chen. Estimate: 5. Due: 2026-03-24.

Add deduplication layer that uses checkpoint token + per-session offset fingerprint; handle partial-token recombine and drop duplicates at the stream fanout. Owner: Mateo Ruiz. Estimate: 3. Due: 2026-03-22.

Adjust backpressure hysteresis to be capacity-aware: introduce soft/hard thresholds tied to cluster headroom and avoid flip-flopping under noisy metrics. Owner: Jenna Park. Estimate: 5. Due: 2026-03-28.

Evolve KV cache resume handshake: make resume tolerant of temporary mismatch by accepting last-known-valid prefix up to N tokens and re-syncing asynchronously. Owner: Priya Nair. Estimate: 5. Due: 2026-03-26.

Create an automated e2e streaming chaos test that injects partial-token writes, socket stalls, and KV eviction race to validate fixes. Add to CI gating for streaming runtime. Owner: Sandeep Rao. Estimate: 8. Due: 2026-04-07.
Update runbook: add 'streaming partial token' playbook, escalation matrix, and Grafana alert tuning. Owner: Reliability team (Jenna Park lead). Estimate: 2. Due: 2026-03-18.

Roll out checkpointed resume token to Dedicated and Hosted with staged canary and a rollback plan; include customer-facing notice for enterprise customers as optional toggle during rollout. Owner: Product (Evelyn Soto). Estimate: 3. Due: 2026-04-01.
